name: Hilton Yaoundé
description: A large international hotel centrally located near government offices and diplomatic missions, with gourmet dining and conference facilities.

name: Hôtel Mont Fébé
description: A mid-range hotel set atop Mont Fébé, offering panoramic views of the city, a pool, and a restaurant serving local and international dishes.

name: Hotel Franco
description: An affordable hotel offering clean, comfortable rooms within walking distance of the city's major attractions.

name: Musée National du Cameroun
description: Cameroon's most comprehensive museum, housed in the former presidential palace, covering the country's history and cultures through artifacts, clothing, and art.

name: Musée Benedictin de Mont-Fébé
description: A small museum known for unique wood carvings and panoramic views over the city, run by the Benedictine community.

name: Blackitude Museum
description: A museum with an impressive collection of tribal masks and artifacts spanning Cameroon's many ethnic groups. Location approximate — confirm before relying on this one.

name: Marché Mokolo
description: One of the city's largest and most vibrant markets — a sensory experience of sights, sounds, and local goods.

name: Marché Central
description: Yaoundé's central market, a good spot for last-minute souvenir shopping and local crafts.

name: PlaYce Yaoundé
description: A large shopping and entertainment center with a Carrefour hypermarket, dozens of stores, restaurants, and family activities.

name: Star Mall
description: A three-level shopping center on Nouvelle Route Bastos with a mix of local and international stores.

name: Dovv Bastos Supermarket
description: A well-known local supermarket chain outlet serving the Bastos neighborhood.

name: Le Tamarin
description: A well-regarded restaurant serving Cameroonian and African cuisine.

name: Pizzeria Glacier Grill Dolcezza
description: A popular pizza spot in the city center, known for a relaxed atmosphere and consistent quality.
